name: Traditional
summary: Traditional is the full ERADICATION mode. The team must capture six enemy territories and defeat the boss.
role: Capture each territory and defend it. Keep enough weapons and ammunition for the boss fight.
fun_facts: Traditional is the only mode that unlocks the boss route.
A full Traditional clock is 48 minutes, which is long enough for lost flags to matter.

name: Rush
summary: Rush is a short defense mode at Furrow. The contractors control Furrow at the start. The Furries win if they capture it.
role: Defend Furrow until the round ends. All weapons are available during this mode.
fun_facts: Rush hides the other territory objectives and only keeps Flag III active.
Rush gives all weapons to each player for the round. Weapon unlocks do not limit the player.

name: Infection
summary: Infection is a 15-minute survival mode. A dead contractor can return as a Furry.
role: Capture territories to reduce the number of enemy spawn locations. Survive until the round ends.
fun_facts: Infection uses Furry-held flags as spawn anchors, so enemy-owned territory changes the shape of the fight.
Whiskerhold remains a defender base spawn in Infection.
